cuts.item: two dean positions (high school and middle school)
one guidance position at middle/high school (offset for assistant principal)
guidance position at the primary school (offset for social worker)
one teaching position at the primary school (second grade classroom collapses to five, added at Turkey Hill)

statements.statement: The recommended FY22 school budget is an overall 2.5 percent increase.
A health insurance premium holiday freed about this amount, letting larger-scenario positions fit in the 2.5 percent budget.
Committee voted to approve the FY22 budget as presented.

warnings.condition: unless the state and federal government really help
warnings.prediction: FY23 budget could look very different without more state and federal help.

warnings.about: guidance staffing at the high school
warnings.condition: if the model is not sufficiently staffed
warnings.prediction: If the guidance staffing model proves inadequate, the administration will return with a different recommendation or restore a guidance position.

warnings.condition: if mandated hours are not met
warnings.prediction: May early release days may be turned back to full days if mandated structured learning hours cannot be met.
